map.为什么入院和出院都要评？: Why assess on both admission and discharge?
map.FIM 的核心价值在「差值」而非单次数值：FIM 效能 =（出院 FIM − 入: The core value of the FIM lies in the difference rather than a single number: FIM efficiency = (discharge FIM - admission FIM) / length of stay, or FIM gain = (discharge - admission) / (maximum possible score - admission score). The admission score alone only shows the care burden and not how fast recovery happens. Scoring must record actual performance rather than potential, and the cognitive and motor subscales should be read separately, since slow cognitive improvement often signals a poorer prognosis.
